description:
Thank you to Snotgoblin terrain and their Future proof terrain for sponsoring this episode!  These terrain sets are easy to assembly and can come pre painted ready to go.  https://futureproof-fw.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders/. Its like lego, but for 40k!  The new kickstarter for their new FACTION war set is finished but they've extended the pre-order window to Nov 14th for those late pledges. so make sure to check it out today!  If your watching from the future make sure to check out their website for more info.


===============GAME INFO=============

Both Nick and Tycho bring heavy hitting lists to this fun halloween live stream game of 40k!  Come Join us!
